revision.tagKindNote: The prior scout described this as tag v0.1.3 without stating its kind. This is recorded as found and corrects nothing the scout asserted.

archiveParity.method: Blob-level: every regular file in the extracted archive was hashed as a git blob object and compared byte-for-byte against the sha recorded for the same path in the recursive git tree. Detail in reconciliation.json.
archiveParity.gitLfsNote: The tree carries no .gitattributes at any depth, so no LFS filter is declared. Every one of the 205 extracted files was nevertheless scanned for the `version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/` pointer header and none was found. LFS absence is established by scanning the bytes, not inferred from the absence of .gitattributes.

networkClosed.note: After the archive fetch, the only further network use in this unit was the package manager's own fetching during the single baseline install, recorded in aggregate in baseline-attempt.json. No further URL was requested by this unit's drivers.

nonclaims: A lightweight tag carries no tagger, no message, and no signature, so it establishes no signer authenticity and no release ceremony; it is a movable pointer upstream and only the commit sha is immutable. The commit itself is unsigned.
